# ===================================================================
# CATEGORIES

@category: Influence
@skills: Bribery, Diplomacy, Duping, Interrogation,
@restricted: —
@stat_bonuses: Pr/Em/In
@rank_progression: Standard
@category_progression: Standard
@group: None
@classification: Static Maneuver
@description:
 Leadership, Propaganda, Public Speaking, Seduction, Trading This category
 encompasses those skills which deal with an intentional and applied effort
 at influencing, manipulating, or deceiving others.

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Bribery
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for offering a bribe to an individual in the
 proper and unobtrusive manner. At the GM’s discretion, this may also allow
 the identification of bribeable individuals; GM may also allow the use of
 this skill to help in identifying persons likely to have been bribed by the
 evidence of unusual behavior.

@@ Diplomacy
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for operating successfully in complex,
 bureaucratic foreign environment, such as a foreign the royal court or any
 other large foreign government structure. Tact, negotiation, and deceit are
 all facets of diplomacy. It is used some the conducting of relations
 between nations. It is important to note that this skill provides a bonus
 for using the proper protocol in unfamiliar situation and impressing a
 person in authority. This applies to situations ranging from an audience
 with the High King to an involuntary meeting with the Prince of Thieves.
 For operating within a familiar government system, refer to Administration.

@@ Duping
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for speaking quickly, convincingly, and
 confusingly in order to get a victim to do something they would not
 ordinarily do. This skill usually may be used on only one person at a time.

@@ Interrogation
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for extracting information from intelligent
 source. This may or may not include causing discomfort to the target.
 However, if a target is discomforted and “interrogation roll” fails, the
 target may suffer a major injury death. In such a case, the target should
 roll an RR vs. level using Co/SD/Co as a modifier to determine the extent
 of injury. This skill not only applies to torture but also includes ability
 to piece together scattered fragments of information ceived. Causing
 “discomfort” to target: +10 to +25

@@ Leadership
@stat: Pr
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus to inspire and command others follow you, and
 to make others believe that you are competent lead and that you know what
 you are doing. This includes ability to raise the morale of those you
 command.

@@ Propaganda
@stat: Re
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for influencing others through indirect means,
 rather than direct speech. Includes such ideas starting rumors, as well as
 designing large advertising campaigns.

@@ Public Speaking
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for impressing, entertaining, manipulating
 groups of people directly. Note that this is different from the Tale
 Telling skill, which is used on small groups, using stories and fables for
 entertainment and instruction. Public Speaking is for larger groups, is
 often more extemporaneous, and is used to manipulate the emotions or views
 of a crowd.

@@ Seduction
@stat: In
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus when attempting to emotionally, sensually, or
 sexually manipulate someone. Note that this is limited to sexual seduction!
 Manipulation of a persons sensual sensibilities, urging a person to indulge
 in some fantasy or desire, and convincing a person of some tenet on
 emotional rather than rational grounds can all be classified as seduction.

@@ Trading
@stat: SD
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus for transactions involving a bargained exchange
 of money or goods, particularly with respect rolls on the purchase and
 resale price charts found in Gamemaster Law.

-26 down | Spectacular Failure | -50% | 1.5u | -30 | You’ve tried your tricks on the wrong person, this time. The worst possible reaction will be engendered in your target(s), and violence is a distinct possibility. With any luck, you’ll just be arrested….
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | -25% | 1.2u | -10 | Your clumsy attempts at manipulation are transparent to all. The GM should roll for the reaction of the target(s), modified by -30. Any future attempt to influence this target will fail unless a result of Absolute Success is achieved.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.0u | +0 | You fail to influence your target in the least. Your target may make a maneuver (open-ended roll modified by 3x Empathy stat bonus) to note your attempt.
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 110% | 0.8u | +20 | Your slick manner and glib words bowl over your target…the target becomes utterly fascinated (enamored) with you, mooning about constantly, attempting to satisfy your every whim and generally getting quite annoying. It gets to the point where it is positively counterproductive (even dangerous) to your business, but the only way you can think to get rid of the person is to shatter his/her fragile ego. What to do, what to do?
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 30% | 1.0u | +0 | You were doing great until you got impatient. You cut to the chase too soon, and your target is wary. If appropriate, roll again on this table next round with a -10 modification.
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 110% | 0.8u | +15 | Something you say seems to bring your target to rigid attention. You can’t figure out what caused it, but your target is frightened nearly to death, and is utterly tractable. If you play it cool, you may continue to influence this individual with a modification of +30, until it either becomes clear to the target that you do not in fact know his secret. However, fear may drive your target to desperate acts…
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.5u | +10 | It’s taken longer than you had hoped, but you’ve almost successfully influenced your target. If appropriate, roll again next round with a +10 modification.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Oh ye of the silver tongue! You smooth-talk your target into tractability. Have you considered a career in politics?
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 0.8u | +30 | You must have been an incubus in a former life. In any case, you have your target(s) wrapped around your little finger, and any reactions are modified by +30 in your favor. This might be a good time to ask about that raise….
